title: Sectionwise prime-field kernel identification for Artin–Schreier data
statement: Let $k$ be a field of prime characteristic $p$, let $C$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $G$ be a sheaf of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with additive equivalences $a_U:G(U)\simeq\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ compatible with restrictions. Let $\iota:\underline{\mathbf Z/p}\to G$ be a sheaf morphism from the constant sheaf [def-sc-constant-sheaves], such that $a_U(\iota_U(\eta_U(c)))=c\cdot1$ for every $c\in\mathbf Z/p$, where $\eta$ is the constant-presheaf sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Then, for every etale object $U$, $\iota_U$ is injective, and every $x\in G(U)$ satisfying $a_U(x)^p=a_U(x)$ is $\iota_U(y)$ for some $y\in\underline{\mathbf Z/p}(U)$. This applies to disconnected and empty objects; y is a constant-sheaf section, not necessarily the image of one single constant.

source.place: Proof, first sentence: the kernel of wp is the constant prime-field sheaf; local-ring calculation and sheaf descent

proof.text: The composite of the constant-presheaf sheafification unit with iota is locally injective. On a nonempty etale object U, a germ map to a nontrivial stalk makes Gamma(U,O) nontrivial. The structural map U -> C -> Spec k implies p=0 in that section ring. By hiota, equality of the images of two constants is equality of their canonical ZMod casts; Mathlib ZMod.castHom_injective proves the constants equal. On an empty object the empty sieve covers (Scheme.Etale.bot_mem_smallEtaleTopology). Mathlib local surjectivity of toSheafify transfers local injectivity of the composite to iota; Sheaf.isLocallyInjective_iff_injective supplies sectionwise injectivity by separatedness.

For a root x and each point z of U, use the structural map and the germ ring homomorphism to make p vanish in the stalk. The germ satisfies its pth-power equation; apply [lem-sc-local-ring-artin-schreier-kernel] to obtain a prime-field constant c. TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq gives an open neighborhood W of z on which x restricts to c.val. The open immersion W -> U is etale, and W -> U -> C is etale by composition. Regard W as an object of C.Etale. The formulas hiota and hrestr, transported by W.topIso, exhibit the restriction of x as the image of the sheafification-unit section represented by c. Therefore the image sieve of x contains an arrow covering each point. Scheme.mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff proves that this image sieve covers; for empty U its pointwise condition is vacuous.

Apply the proved private helper lift_of_imageSieve_mem to the underlying Type-valued sheaf map. Choose one local preimage on every arrow of the covering image sieve. Their images are restrictions of x, so naturality and sectionwise injectivity make this family compatible. The source sheaf condition glues the family to y. Naturality shows iota(y) is an amalgamation of the image family, and x is another; target separatedness gives iota(y)=x. This includes empty covers and does not require a single globally constant representative.

lean.statement:
theorem artinSchreier_kernel_sections
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime)
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (iota : C.constantZMod p ⟶ G)
    (hrestr : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (hiota : ∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
      a U (iota.hom.app U
        ((toSheafify C.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const C.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
        (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))) :
    ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (iota.hom.app U) ∧
      ∀ x : G.obj.obj U, (a U x) ^ p = a U x → ∃ y, iota.hom.app U y = x
